title: Fail-closed NEOARM condenser audit without calibrated deflector angle or sample tilt
scope: local matched-model upper-bound Fisher audit; not nonlinear recovery or hardware admission
coordinate_status: normalized synthetic lens controls; instrument raw-command continuations remain unmeasured

paper.citation: Pfeifer, Lupini, and Hoglund, A versatile generalized digital twin for Electron Microscopy, arXiv:2607.29411v1

supported: Fit an integrated detector-intensity/beam-current curve while sweeping a lens preceding a known aperture; the released fitting script normalizes each curve.
Use paired lens wobbles and zero beam-diameter sensitivity as critical-condition initializers.
Use rotation in addition to focusing to separate effective field strength from lens length.
Pure beam-shift rotation measurements were reported as commonly too noisy; large shifts can introduce coma.
Defocused registered Ronchigram images were the authors' preferred rotation method in the demonstrated downstream setting.
not_transferred_without_proof: An ordinary image of a specimen downstream of the condenser does not measure condenser Larmor rotation.
A defocused Ronchigram constrains the condenser only when the forward model contains the incident angle-to-sample mapping or a transported non-axisymmetric illumination tag.
The paper does not establish recovery of every NEOARM lens position, effective length, bias, and raw-command slope without current readback.
paper_claim_arbitrage.neoarm_extension: Retain raw Poisson counts with interleaved aperture-out dose references instead of normalizing away intensity. Use a deliberately astigmatic incident beam generated upstream of every fitted condenser lens as the primary rotation tag. Its command strength need not be calibrated: fit the shared entrance ellipse through the ten entrance-covariance nuisances and use only state-relative orientation. If the stigmator/tag is downstream, its physical plane and transport map must be modeled and it cannot identify lenses upstream of that plane.

C_aperture.fit_data: raw Poisson counts plus aperture-out dose references
C_aperture.audit_upper_bound: the numerical audit grants the existing 21-position translated-edge traversal at each of four optical states; paper-style centred throughput/wobble curves are a weaker subset
C_aperture.traversal_requirement: translation must be mechanical or produced upstream of the 0.250 m aperture with a calibrated physical displacement; the 0.290/0.295 m downstream deflector cannot perform it
C_aperture.critical_wobble_statistic: [log T(u + delta e_i) - log T(u - delta e_i)] / (2 delta)
C_aperture.critical_root_use: initialization only; the likelihood fits raw counts
C_aperture.important_zero: the C aperture is upstream of C-mini and has exactly zero direct C-mini sensitivity

measurement_contract.sample_spatial: Two registered RMS widths and their correlation from known-object intensity images; one shared real-space scale nuisance is always released unless explicitly marked fixed synthetic truth.

rotation.tag_plane_requirement: upstream of CL1, or an explicitly modeled stigmator plane/map
rotation.shared_ellipticity_and_orientation: contained in the fitted entrance covariance
rotation.frame_contract: 32 separate tagged projection exposures (one reference plus 31 varied states); if orientation and spatial covariance are extracted from the same pixels, replace the independent design covariance by one joint pixel/bootstrap covariance

indexed_si_angular_radius.observable: log convergence radius from disk-radius / reciprocal-vector-radius
indexed_si_angular_radius.calibration: alpha = (lambda / d) * (r_disk / r_g), so detector pixel size and camera length cancel

explicit_nuisances: shared aperture radius and aperture-translation scale
shared indexed-Si lambda/d scale when diffraction is used

D_conditional_strong_dual_scale_and_rota.status: optimistic conditional local upper bound only; both scale priors, rotation precision, and the assumed independent-summary covariance must be demonstrated or replaced by a joint pixel/bootstrap covariance

position_only_null_direction.normalization: unit Euclidean norm in the twelve scaled target coordinates; overall sign arbitrary
position_only_null_direction.interpretation: q-free axial dilation: common effective-length change with compensating centre shifts; relative Larmor rotation cannot see it

rejected_full_angular_ellipse_search.status: rejected; no control prescription or sub-1-percent claim is retained
rejected_full_angular_ellipse_search.reason: the exploratory selector appended states after its physical eligibility filter; its most repeated state produced approximately 3.57 and 2.70 micrometre sample widths, outside the required 30-200 nm window
rejected_full_angular_ellipse_search.scientific_consequence: the algebraic 12/12 result is not a physically admissible experiment and must not be used for frame counts, precision, or hardware planning
rejected_full_angular_ellipse_search.replacement: superseded by the separately checksum-bound strict astigmatic design below; this rejected candidate remains only as negative provenance

strict_astigmatic_replacement.status: conditional local design; not hardware admission
strict_astigmatic_replacement.spatial_eligibility: every expanded state has 30-200 nm equivalent specimen-plane RMS
strict_astigmatic_replacement.critical_warning: the sub-one-percent result has almost no margin and remains conditional on the declared scale, angular-covariance, tag-plane, repeatability, and image-bootstrap gates

admission_gate.minimum_extra_anchor: an independently calibrated angular/wavefront scale plus a registered real-space scale, or an independent objective-prefield/axial-plane anchor; the reported conditional result additionally requires the mechanically/upstream translated C-aperture block
required_next: measure the sample-atlas/downstream real-space scale posterior rather than assuming it
demonstrate the translated C-aperture traversal; do not transfer the conditional result to centred-throughput-only data
validate Si ratio angular calibration including voltage and distortion covariance
demonstrate a stable non-circular incident ellipse and <= 1 mrad relative orientation uncertainty
generate the ellipse upstream of CL1 or include the actual stigmator plane and map in the fit
measure a joint covariance when tag orientation and spatial covariance share detector pixels
validate the checksum-bound strict astigmatic replacement on the instrument; its normalized controls are not hardware DAC commands
re-optimize raw lens states over the measured safe hardware continuation
pass truth-envelope rank, joint nuisance-released nonlinear multistart, profile likelihood, approach-direction, and held-out tests
